head_commit.message:
feat(admin): V34.9 auto-scrape komentar majangmejeng (IG Jina + TT TikWM)

- scripts/scrape-comments-tt.mjs: TikWM free endpoint, 8 posts scraped, 24 comments
- scripts/scrape-comments-ig.mjs: Jina web proxy fallback for IG post pages
- scripts/aggregate-admin-comments.mjs: dedup + merge scraped + manual → admin-comments.json
- KomentarAdmin.jsx: Akun filter (Semua/Majangmejeng/Akun Lain)
- daily-update.yml: 3 new steps (scrape IG comments, scrape TT comments, aggregate)

Build green: vite-index.template-BNekfYZA.js (96.72 kB)

feat(admin): Komentar Admin tab + V34 ship

- src/data/admin-comments.json: 12 sample comments Aug 1-12 2026
  with admin markers (-Rf/-Rm/-Re/-Ju)
- src/lib/adminComments.js + test: marker detect, normalize, KPI
  builders (admin/monthly/by-post), 20/20 vitest pass
- src/components/admin/KomentarAdmin.jsx: KPI strip + 4 admin cards
  + bar chart + monthly KPI table + admin/month filters + per-post
  comment samples (5 default, expand)
- src/routes/Admin.jsx: mount <KomentarAdmin /> at end
- scripts/copy-data-to-public.mjs: loop src/data/*.json so admin-comments
  ships to public/data/ + deploy auto-publishes to root
- account_card / proxied_avatar: V33.5 polish (from cron 008c57e)
- new bundle: vite-index.template-uJxzLTb1.js + Admin-BhHEIhcn.js
chore: remove accidentally committed tmp-acc.json debug file

fix(v32.3): normalizePost createTime fallback adds raw.timestamp (sec normalize)

Free IG scraper V28 only writes timestamp field, never createTime. Fallback chain missing raw.timestamp → 572 IG posts had createTime=0 → dataStore filter excluded → LiveActivityFeed showed only TT even though 85 IG posts dated Aug 2026 existed.

Fix: add raw.timestamp to chain + >1e12 sec normalization (handles both ms ENSEMBLEDATA history and sec free scraper output).

3 regression tests added. Live E2E: top 10 = 9 IG + 1 TT (was 0 IG + 10 TT), filtered = 0 (was 572).
fix(v32.2.1): mobile overflow on 320px bento (text-lg→text-base, min-w-0, truncate)

v30.3: AI hallucination fix - inject ground-truth daftar 9 akun

User reported: tanya 'sebutkan semua akun di dashboard' → AI jawab 8 akun,
salah claim @syahfalahproperti tidak punya akun TT, halusinasi
@ardiantanahmenjawab muncul 2x karena 'endpoint berbeda'.

Root cause: buildCrossAccountBlock() di memoryInjector.js:176-204 cuma
inject 3 top-5 ranking (ER/Followers/Posts) = 15 baris. Akun ranked 6-9
di semua kategori (tt-syahfalahproperti: rank 7-9 di semua) invisible
ke AI. LLM behavior: kalau tidak punya data, fabricate penjelasan
teknis yang meyakinkan tapi salah.

Fix: tambah block 'Daftar Lengkap 9 Akun' (ground truth) setelah
top-5 rankings. Sort IG-first lalu TT, alphabetical dalam platform
(deterministic → LLM bisa enumerate benar). +280 tokens ke system
prompt, well within Gemini Flash-Lite 1M context.

E2E verified:
- Simulated new block output: tt-syahfalahproperti visible (1.155
  followers, 413 posts, ER 1.91%)
- pnpm run deploy:dry build: 8.24s, bundle HxgcxZK1, 6 Worker URL refs
- New scripts/test-ai-system-prompt.mjs smoke test: PASS, all 9
  accounts present in cross-account block

Run smoke test anytime: node scripts/test-ai-system-prompt.mjs
